title: For all: признанная трудность
description: For all: признанная трудность: чтение оригинального текста, контекстный словарь и точное описание ситуации с объяснениями ответов.
objectives: Найти в тексте ответ на вопрос «Какую пользу давало руководство?»
Различать значения concession и limitation в теме «For all: признанная трудность»
notes: В предложении «The guide is useful despite its limitations.» подлежащее в единственном числе согласуется с is.
При чтении важно сохранить факт или границу вывода: «It acknowledges limitations while retaining a limited positive judgement.»

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

Вставь слово из пары limitations / concession. Значение: «Руководство полезно, несмотря на ограничения.»

public_payload.passage: For all its limitations, the guide helped new volunteers identify the correct contact for common questions. A reviewer paraphrased the sentence as saying that the limitations were imaginary. The author objected: the concessive phrase acknowledged them while retaining a positive judgement about a particular use. The guide still omitted unusual cases and needed updating when staff roles changed. Its usefulness did not establish completeness, and incompleteness did not establish total uselessness. The revised review named the limited task the guide supported and the situations in which readers would need additional help. This gave prospective users a more precise account of what they could reasonably expect.

options.label: Finding the correct contact for common questions.
Preventing staff roles from ever changing.
